clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in 
me by section 1 of the act of August 1,
1914, 38 Stat. 609, 623 (U.S.C., title 19, 
sec. 2), the designations of Cordova, 
Alaska, and Mahukona, Hawaii, as cus­
toms ports of entry in Customs Collec- 
titon District No. 31 (Alaska) and Cus- ' 
toms Collection District No. 32 (Hawaii), 
respectively, are hereby revoked.
This order shall become effective on 
the thirtieth day from the date hereof.
